close_reason: code_signing_policy implemented: 1185-day cap, SHA-1 excluded, min 3072-bit RSA, no SAN required, require codeSigning EKU. Tests pass.
description:
Implement code_signing_policy(now_unix) in pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs to return a ValidationPolicy enforcing CA/B Forum Code Signing Baseline Requirements (current version: v3.4+).

Constraints to set:
- max_validity_secs: 1185 * 86400  (1185 days / ~39 months, per CS BR §6.3.2)
- allowed_signature_algs: SHA-1 excluded. SHA-256/384/512 RSA and ECDSA allowed. Note: CS BR §6.1.5 also prohibits SHA-1 for signing certificates themselves.
- min_rsa_key_bits: 3072  (CS BR §6.1.5 — raised to 3072 bits effective 2023-06-01, higher than TLS BR)
- require_subject_alt_name: false  (CS certs identify subjects by DN, not SAN)
- required_leaf_eku: [id-kp-codeSigning]  (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.3)

Remove the unimplemented!() panic. Update rustdoc.

Note for implementor: the 3072-bit RSA minimum is the key differentiator from web_pki_policy (2048 bits). Verify the min_rsa_key_bits field from PKIX-ken.1 is enforced against the leaf's SPKI, not the intermediate's.

Tests:
- Cert with id-kp-codeSigning EKU passes
- Cert missing id-kp-codeSigning rejected
- RSA 2048-bit leaf rejected (below 3072 floor)
- RSA 3072-bit leaf accepted
- SHA-1 cert rejected
- Cert exceeding 1185 days rejected
title: Implement code_signing_policy (CA/B Forum CS BR)
